config.comment.alloweating: If enabled, holding food and eating will not be blocked by Easy Place mode.
config.comment.allowfirework: If enabled, using fireworks while flying with elytra will not be blocked by Easy Place mode.
config.comment.allowshulkerbox: If enabled, you can open placed shulker boxes while holding blocks, and place shulker boxes without Easy Place interception.
config.comment.enableblockblacklist: If enabled, blocks in the blacklist will not be blocked by Easy Place mode.
config.comment.blockblacklist: Blocks listed here will not be blocked by Easy Place mode (one block ID per line, e.g. minecraft:chest).
config.comment.allowliquidplacement: [Experimental] If enabled, liquid source blocks in the schematic will be handled by Easy Place (auto-pick bucket, precise placement). Empty buckets will not be allowed to pick up schematic liquids.
config.comment.allowwaterloggedplacement: [Experimental] If enabled, waterlogged blocks in the schematic will be handled by Easy Place (place water first, then block; or waterlog existing blocks). Requires both the block and a water bucket in inventory. Requires "Allow Liquid Placement" to also be enabled.
config.comment.easyplaceswinghand: If enabled, the player's hand swings when Easy Place places a block. (Feature backported from Litematica 1.21+)
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.bettereas: A mod that improves the easy place functionality of Litematica
